name: @vssaros/dsh-agents
description: VsSaros agents module for DeepSeek Harness: registers ~/.vssaros/agents/<id>/.agent.md as dsh agent presets (persona via a system-prompt section, model via @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model), offers in-session persona hot switching (durable-inbox injection + log-derived projection; preset identity stays locked), ships our own agent preset (R13: official `standard` copy + our tool-bearing rows, see preset-sync.mjs), plus a self-hosted read-only roster page. Data contract: src/vs/sessions/contrib/agentStudio/common/agentMdFormat.ts
